Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp`** in `src/num.js` — limits n to [min, max] with early returns
2. **`formatBytes`** in `src/util.js` — formats bytes using B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place (except bytes, which rounds to integer)
3. **`slugify`** in `src/text.js` — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-alphanumeric chars except dashes

All are exported and follow the project's coding style.
